scope: Current stored model-authored/modified game translation resources, previous v1 changes, fragments, pending pages and independently authored Chinese expectations. Not deleted historical drafts or generated display copies.
definition: Authorship-based broad inventory, not a count of novel wording. Directly authored text remains included even if it happens to equal an RSC phrase. Explicit original retention, verified lexical copying and mechanical expansion are separately classified. model_reviewed alone is never used as proof of generation.
deduplication: Exact Chinese plus Japanese/source key with whitespace removed; ignore game duplicates, preserve Chinese punctuation/width and slot names. Different contexts may contain the same words. Whole annotated regions and their segmented units are not added together.

derived.note: 354 preexpanded move forms plus 36 copied/composed dictionary records; not separately generated by an LLM for each displayed name/value.

additionalDuplicateContainers: corpus/s6/tv-page-reviews.json: records[].chinesePages duplicate the 403 saved pages
corpus/acceptance/annotations.mjs and reference.groups carry the same source expectations
reference.regions, predictions/evaluation, output-judgments, HTML/CSV reports and runtime copies do not represent new independent authorship

limitations: This is current stored text, not the unknowable number of all sampled/generated drafts.
No finding that each model-authored item was necessary, correct, independently reviewed, or originally missing from RSC.
A runtime pair means those text values are present; it does not approve every original source identity or Java/live output.
The prior 685 was a partial body-difference comparison, not total model authorship.
